sec.title: Case A: T41A in EXAMPLE
sec.p:
The EXAMPLE variant c.123A>G, p.T41A, was observed. Sanger sequencing confirmed the heterozygous variant in the proband and its absence in both parents.
(A) Other panel. (B) Sanger sequencing of the patient and parents to show that the heterozygous mutation is de novo. SNP analysis confirmed both maternity and paternity.
